Frequently asked questions

## Questions about TrackTik pricing

How do I get TrackTik pricing?

Fill in the request pricing form on this page. A TrackTik specialist follows up within one business day to understand your operation, then shares a quote built around it along with a 30-minute walkthrough.

What information do you need to prepare a quote?

It helps to know the sites you protect, the size of your team, the modules you are interested in, and the systems you want TrackTik to connect with, such as payroll, accounting or alarm monitoring. Your specialist will confirm anything else during the follow-up call.

Can I start with a few modules and add more later?

Yes. Many teams start with guard tours and incident reporting, then add modules such as scheduling and attendance, contracts and invoicing, business intelligence or visitor management when they are ready. See the [Back Office Operating System Suite](https://www.trackforce.com/products/tracktik/back-office-operating-system-suite/) for the back office modules.

How long does implementation take?

Typical time to launch is 6 to 8 weeks. You get a dedicated onboarding lead, data migration and system integration handled by the Trackforce team, and role-specific training through TrackTik Academy. Timelines scale with the modules you turn on. Learn more about [implementation services](https://www.trackforce.com/support/implementation-services-overview/).

Does TrackTik integrate with our payroll, accounting and security systems?

Yes, with two-way sync and no double entry. Connectors include ADP, Paycor and Criterion for payroll and HR, QuickBooks, Sage Intacct and Xero for accounting, and Immix, RightCrowd and Scylla AI for security and monitoring. Anything else can connect through a documented REST API. See all [TrackTik integrations](https://www.trackforce.com/products/integrations/).

What security certifications does TrackTik hold?

TrackTik is independently audited for SOC 2 Type II and certified to ISO 27001 and ISO 27017, and it supports NIST 800-171, GDPR and CCPA requirements.

Is TrackTik for security firms or in-house security teams?

Both. [Security firms](https://www.trackforce.com/who-we-serve/organization-types/security-firms/) use TrackTik to protect margin and prove service delivery to clients, and [enterprise security teams](https://www.trackforce.com/who-we-serve/organization-types/enterprise-security/) use it to run one standardized program across sites, vendors and countries. TrackTik is deployed in more than 50 countries and supports 55 languages.

Can I see TrackTik before I buy?

Yes. You can book a 30-minute live walkthrough of the command center, scheduling, billing and business intelligence, mapped to how your operation runs. [Get a demo](https://www.trackforce.com/get-a-demo/) to schedule one.
